format: one JSON file per entity, files[<key>].path: {"cube", "entity", "columns", "rows", "period_columns", "periods": [[values in period_columns order]]}; rows join the period table on grain and period
manifest_hash_method: sha256 of data/opm_manifest.json canonical content: records sorted by (dataset, filename), json.dumps(sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
spec: docs/metric-spec.md (signed; sections 3, 4, 7 KDI-011, 9 M-1, D-040); docs/cube-plan.md Amendment 2 and docs/occupation-spec.md sections 4b, 5, 8 (signed, D-039, D-040)

not_reported.name: Not reported
not_reported.rule: series: occupational_series_code NULL, blank (' ', published as "NO DATA REPORTED") or '*' (INVALID); family: the series is not reported, or occupational_group_code is NULL or blank (a series with no published family). Its own occupation at each level, never dropped or shared out; counts only, no rate (the occupations cube)

occupations.name_rule: each code's published name, latest spelling (the latest month with a non-null name; the employment file before the action files of the same month); families are OPM's published occupational_group_code and occupational_group (D-039), never derived from the series digits

files_digest_method: sha256 of the lines '<path> <sha256>\n' for every file, sorted by path

grains.fy: fiscal year, every year in the entity span; rate = method B (year to date over its published months when partial, not annualized)
grains.t12: the latest 12 months only (the window ending at the latest month), for every entity with a month inside it, over the entity's months in the window (partial when fewer than 12); headcount at the entity's last month in the window; rate = method A
grains.admin: an administration's whole window (Trump II so far); rate annualized x 12 / months
grains.admin_n: months 1..N in office for every administration, N = admin_n_months (the open administration's months so far); rate annualized as admin

rate_methods: Each row carries one rate denominator, the method its grain defines (metric spec section 3, as the leaving and joining cubes): fy rows method B, t12 rows method A, admin rows annualized; method C at quarter or month grain is not carried because the cube has no quarter or month rows, and the monthly occupation cubes carry headcount, hires and departures from which the page computes all three methods.
row_rule: one row per period, level and occupation with a hire, a departure or headcount at period end

columns.name: grain
columns.description: 'fy' (fiscal year), 't12' (the latest 12 months only, ending at the latest month), 'admin' (an administration's whole window) or 'admin_n' (its months 1..N in office, N = admin_n_months)

columns.name: period
columns.description: 'FYyyyy' at fy grain; 'YYYY-MM' (the latest month) at t12 grain; the administration id at admin and admin_n grain; rows join the file's period table on grain and period; its months_published is the number of month-end headcounts averaged into rate_den

columns.name: level
columns.description: 'series' (occupational_series_code as published) or 'family' (OPM's published occupational_group_code, D-039); each level partitions the entity on its own

columns.name: occupation
columns.description: the series or family code; 'NR' = Not reported (KDI-011): series blank, ' ' or '*' (INVALID), and at family level also a series with no published group code; names in meta occupations

columns.name: hires
columns.description: accession rows effective in the window with this occupation (new hires and transfers in)

columns.name: departures
columns.description: separation rows effective in the window with this occupation (transfers out and DRP included)

columns.name: acc_transfer_in
columns.description: hires with accession code AA + AB (transfers in)

columns.name: sep_transfer_out
columns.description: departures with separation code SA + SB (transfers out)

columns.name: sep_drp
columns.description: departures with drp_indicator = 'Y' (deferred resignations), any code

columns.name: headcount
columns.description: employment rows with this occupation in the file of the period's period_last_month; not derived from flows: employees also change series without a hire or departure (invariant 7)

columns.name: hire_num
columns.description: hire rate numerator: hires (admin and admin_n: x 12 / months_published, annualized); rate = hire_num / rate_den; null when there is no rate

columns.name: attrition_num
columns.description: departure rate numerator: departures (admin and admin_n: x 12 / months_published, annualized); rate = attrition_num / rate_den; null when there is no rate

columns.name: rate_den
columns.description: mean month-end headcount of the occupation over the period's published months (fy: method B, year to date when partial; t12: method A; admin grains: the window); null (never 0) when that mean is 0, and on 'NR' rows (KDI-011: counts only)

columns.name: rate_small_base
columns.description: rate_den < 30 (invariant 9): shown with a flag, never hidden; null when there is no rate

period_columns.name: fiscal_year
period_columns.description: fiscal year of the period (of its last month at t12 grain); null at admin grains

period_columns.name: period_first_month
period_columns.description: first calendar month of the window (YYYY-MM), published or not

period_columns.name: period_last_month
period_columns.description: last published month of the window within the entity's span: the month stocks are taken from

period_columns.name: months_in_period
period_columns.description: months in the full window: 12; admin grain: the administration's published months (Trump II so far); admin_n grain: N

period_columns.name: months_published
period_columns.description: months of the window with a published employment file within the entity's span

period_columns.name: provisional
period_columns.description: the window contains any of the newest 3 months (invariant 8)

period_columns.name: partial
period_columns.description: a fiscal year with months not yet published or outside the entity's span; at admin grains, an administration still in office (Trump II) or a window cut by the entity's span

period_columns.name: reissued
period_columns.description: a month of the window changed file version since the previous manifest (revision_baseline.json)

period_columns.name: opm_incomplete
period_columns.description: a month of the window OPM marks incomplete for this entity (KDI-006)

period_columns.name: kdi_ids
period_columns.description: known data issue ids touching a month of the window: entity-month flags, plus the ids of length-of-service values treated as unknown on the cube's action rows (KDI-001, KDI-009, KDI-010)
